senses.gloss: f. (עָלַל; cmp. בִּילָה fr. בָּלַל) [going about, bringing about; cmp. סִיבָּה end,]

units: Keth. 20ᵇ ע׳ מצאו וטהרו וכ׳ they found some (paltry) reason to declare clean a spot in the land of Israel; Naz. 65ᵇ עילא; [Rashi: עילא = עילעא rib of a human body].
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 3:10:2">Y. Keth. III, end, 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מצאתי ע׳ לשחררו</he> I have found an opportunity to set him free.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:5:6">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:9:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>על ידי ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00042"><he>זְבִינְתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>; s. 45; s. 63 <he>ואף היא על ידי ע׳</he> and even this in a round-about way (indirectly); a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 5:7">Eduy. V, 7</cite> <he>שמא ע׳ מצאת בי</he> (Mish. ed. <cite ref="P00250"><he>עַוְלָה</he></cite>; Ms. M. <cite ref="P00244"><he>עָוֶל</he></cite>) hast thou found any falsehood in me? <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28:1">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite> <he>נפלו עליהם בע׳</he> they turned against them with insidiousness.—V. <cite ref="P00804"><he>עֲלִילָה</he></cite>.
